title: Help Me, O Lord My God

questions.question: Be not silent, O God of my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:1 (ESV): "Be not silent, O God of my praise!"

questions.question: For wicked and deceitful mouths are opened against me, speaking against me with lying what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:2 (ESV): "...speaking against me with lying tongues."

questions.question: They encircle me with words of hate, and attack me without what?
In return for my love they accuse me, but I give myself to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:4 (ESV): "...but I give myself to prayer."

questions.question: So they reward me evil for good, and hatred for my what?
Appoint a wicked man against him; let an accuser stand at his right what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:6 (ESV): "...let an accuser stand at his right hand."

questions.question: When he is tried, let him come forth guilty; let his prayer be counted as what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:7 (ESV): "...let his prayer be counted as sin!"

questions.question: May his days be few; may another take his what?
May his children be fatherless and his wife a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:9 (ESV): "May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow!"

questions.question: May his children wander about and beg, seeking food far from the ruins they do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:10 (ESV): "...seeking food far from the ruins they inhabit!"

questions.question: May he be clothed with cursing as his coat; may it soak into his body like what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:18 (ESV): "...may it soak into his body like water,"

questions.question: But you, O God my Lord, deal on my behalf for your name's sake; because your steadfast love is good, do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:21 (ESV): "...because your steadfast love is good, deliver me!"

questions.question: I am poor and needy, and my heart is what within me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:22 (ESV): "...and my heart is stricken within me."

questions.question: I am gone like a shadow at evening; I am shaken off like a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:23 (ESV): "...I am shaken off like a locust."

questions.question: Let them curse, but you will bless! They arise and are put to shame, but your servant will be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 109:28 (ESV): "...but your servant will be glad!"

key_verse_text: Help me, O Lord my God! Save me according to your steadfast love!
